basic_details.job_title: MACT Nalbari Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Sheristadar/ Chief Administrative Officer Posts

important_dates.interview_date: To be notified in due course

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | sheristadar/chief administrative officer (c.a.o): Graduate from a recognized university in any discipline. Must have been serving for at least 6 years and above as U.D Assistant/S.A. Assistant in the offices of District & Sessions Judges/Additional District & Sessions Judges/Family Court/MACT or any other equivalent Institutions of Assam District Judiciary.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs/- 30,000-1,10,000/- with Grade Pay of Rs/- 14,500/- (ROP Rules 2017)

selection_process: The provisional short listed candidates will be called for interview/viva-voce. The final selection will be made on the basis of the marks obtained by the candidates in interview/viva-voce only.
how_to_apply: Obtain the Standard Form of application published in Assam Gazette Part-IX.
Fill up the application form completely with all required details.
Enclose the experience certificate issued by the competent authority along with all relevant testimonials and educational qualification documents.
Attach age proof certificate, copy of Service Book, and copy of ACR for the last five years.
Enclose three copies of recent passport size photographs.
Ensure contact number and e-mail ID are provided mandatorily in the application form.
Submit the application through proper channel.

Send the application by post or place it in the Drop Box labeled as "Drop Box for applications for the post of Sheristadar/ CAO" addressed to the "Office of the Presiding Officer/ Member, MACT, Nalbari, PIN-781335" on or before 15/10/2026 (5.00 PM).
important_instructions: Applications must be submitted through proper channel. No postal delay will be considered for applications received after the last date. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Applicants must mandatorily provide their contact number and e-mail ID in the application form. Candidates must produce testimonials in original if selected for interview, failing which candidature will be rejected. Candidates shall appear before the Selection Board for interview/viva-voce at their own expenses; no TA/DA is applicable. No individual call letter will be issued for appearing in the interview/viva-voce. Canvassing directly or indirectly will disqualify candidature.

faq.question: Q1. What is MACT Nalbari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: MACT Nalbari Recruitment 2026 is an offline recruitment process announced by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Nalbari to fill 1 vacant post of Sheristadar/Chief Administrative Officer (C.A.O).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MACT Nalbari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Sheristadar/Chief Administrative Officer (C.A.O) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for MACT Nalbari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the application form is 15/10/2026 on or before 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible to apply for the Sheristadar/CAO post?
faq.answer: Eligible employees serving as U.D Assistant/S.A. Assistant for at least 6 years in the offices of District & Sessions Judges or equivalent institutions of Assam District Judiciary and holding a Graduate degree can apply.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale for MACT Nalbari Sheristadar/CAO?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a pay scale of Rs/- 30,000-1,10,000/- with Grade Pay of Rs/- 14,500/- and other allowances under ROP Rules 2017.
